summary: Core auth modules (src/) are small, typed, and well-tested, but the eval harness duplicates utilities across files, contains god functions, and mixes transport concerns with domain logic. Two broad except Exception handlers and duplicated JWT signing weaken maintainability.

criteria_results.evidence: tests/eval/report.py:generate_report (163 lines) builds summary, histogram, category/difficulty tables, regressions, clusters, recommendations, and failure details in one function. tests/eval/run_eval.py:print_report (87 lines) duplicates overlapping reporting responsibilities.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Extract report sections into focused builders (SummarySection, CategoryTable, FailureDetails) and compose them in generate_report.

criteria_results.evidence: src/ has no classes. Eval dataclasses (JudgeResult, CriterionResult) are cohesive.
tests/eval/judge.py:call_llm uses if/elif for two providers — acceptable at current scale. No growing switch chains in src/.
No inheritance hierarchies in project source.
No Protocol/ABC interfaces defined.

src/token_validation.py:11 imports private _b64url_decode/_b64url_encode and SECRET from src.auth. tests/eval/judge.py:call_llm directly instantiates OpenAI/Anthropic clients with no injectable abstraction.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Extract jwt_utils.py with public encode/decode/sign helpers; inject secret via config. Introduce a JudgeClient protocol for LLM calls to enable testing without network.

criteria_results.evidence: 6 functions exceed 50 lines: generate_report (163), print_report (87), auto_capture.main (70), generate_recommendations (55), check_regressions (55), capture.main (55). src/ functions all under 20 lines.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Split generate_report and print_report into section helpers; keep CLI main() as thin orchestration.

criteria_results.evidence: 4 files flagged over 200 lines (run_eval.py 242, judge.py 243, report.py 263, stats.py 227). None exceed 300-line fail threshold.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Consider extracting shared eval utilities to reduce file size drift.

criteria_results.evidence: generate_report has ~26 decision points (threshold 10). print_report and check_regressions also elevated.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Decompose generate_report into pure functions per section; use early returns to flatten branching.

criteria_results.evidence: print_report reaches 5 indentation levels (tests/eval/run_eval.py:215-221 nested loops over failures/criteria).
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Extract failure detail printing into a helper; use guard clauses at loop start.

criteria_results.evidence: Names are clear throughout (verify_token, hash_password, cluster_failures). No ambiguous single-letter identifiers outside loop counters.
Consistent load_* / show_* / generate_* conventions in eval tooling.

load_dataset() duplicated in run_eval.py, capture.py, auto_capture.py. filter_dataset duplicated in run_eval.py and auto_capture.py. load_baseline/load_latest_run duplicated in report.py and stats.py. JWT HMAC signing duplicated in auth.create_token and token_validation.verify_token. Reporting logic duplicated between run_eval.print_report and report.generate_report.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Create tests/eval/common.py with shared dataset/response/history loaders; extract jwt signing to shared helper.

criteria_results.evidence: REGRESSION_THRESHOLD=0.10 in stats.py but inline -0.10 in report.py:251. EVAL_DIR/HISTORY_DIR path constants repeated across 5 eval files. SECRET hardcoded in src/auth.py:13.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Centralize paths and thresholds in eval/config.py; load SECRET from environment with dev default.

criteria_results.evidence: token_validation depends on auth private symbols. Eval modules cross-copy logic instead of importing shared module, increasing cascade risk when response layout changes.
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Public jwt module boundary; single shared eval utilities module.

criteria_results.evidence: src/auth.py and src/token_validation.py are focused. Eval files are cohesive per script purpose despite internal bloat.
except Exception in tests/eval/judge.py:301 and tests/eval/auto_capture.py:154. src/token_validation.py correctly catches (ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError).
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Catch specific LLM/network/JSON errors in judge; log and re-raise unexpected errors in auto_capture.

criteria_results.evidence: verify_token returns HTTP status tuples (401/200) mixing validation with transport layer (src/token_validation.py:27-43).
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Return domain result (ValidToken | InvalidToken); map to HTTP at API boundary.

criteria_results.evidence: 100% type coverage on public functions in src/ and tests/. TypedDict used for token bodies. dict[str, Any] only on parsed JWT payload (justified).
tests/test_auth.py covers valid token, expired token, invalid token, and password hash round-trip (4 tests, multiple edge cases for auth critical paths).
criteria_results.fix_suggestion: Add tests for signature tampering and missing sub claim in verify_token.

top_recommendations: Extract tests/eval/common.py to deduplicate load_dataset, filter_dataset, load_baseline, and response discovery
Split generate_report (163 lines, complexity 26) into composable section functions
Create src/jwt_crypto.py with shared signing/verification; stop importing private _b64url_* from auth
Replace except Exception with specific error types in judge.py and auto_capture.py
Decouple verify_token from HTTP status codes — return typed domain results instead
